description: Read-only mapping from source-media time ranges to placements on one sequence track. Reads the selected track once, maps only normal-speed forward clips, reports source portions not present on the track as unplaced, and returns bounded pages. This inspects timeline placement; it does not prove rendered or audible content.

media_path.description: Exact media path returned by Premiere to match. Provide this or source_project_item_id.

range_limit.description: Maximum mapped ranges per page (default: 50, maximum: 200). Payload budget may shorten the page.

range_offset.description: Zero-based offset into the input ranges after mapping (default: 0). Follow nextOffset to continue.

end_seconds.description: Exclusive end in source-media seconds; must exceed start_seconds.

sequence_id.description: Sequence name or ID; uses the active sequence when omitted.

source_project_item_id.description: Project item node ID to match. Provide this or media_path.

track_index.description: Zero-based index within the selected track collection.

name: map_source_ranges_to_timeline

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Map Source Ranges To Timeline
